benchmarks.description: The pipeline must include a step to scan for hardcoded secrets, API keys, or tokens before deployment (e.g., using Gitleaks, Trufflehog, or GitHub Secret Scanning).
The pipeline must run a SAST scanner relative to the language used (e.g., Bandit for Python, SonarQube, Semgrep) to identify code vulnerabilities.
The workflow must check third-party packages and dependencies for known vulnerabilities (e.g., using Snyk, OWASP Dependency-Check, or Trivy).
If the pipeline deploys infrastructure (Terraform, Dockerfiles, Kubernetes manifests), it must include a linting/scanning step (e.g., Checkov, Hadolint) to block misconfigurations.
Workflow tokens or cloud provider authentication (like AWS OIDC roles) must use explicitly defined minimum scopes. Broad, unmasked administrative tokens are strictly forbidden.
